text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka takes 1st!
It's Silence Suzuka, the "Otherworldly Front-Runner"!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: She's the strongest active racer—no, a living legend...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
I... I did it...! I took the lead!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"In this race...! In the Autumn Tenno Sho,
I was able to see that view... with my own eyes...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Beyond cutting through the thumping heartbeats of so many Umamusume...
Even further past the finish line—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —It was the quietest, most beautiful sight yet...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I entered this race today...! I'm so glad I could run!

The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
The cheering did not die down for quite some time.
